title: Francis Coates-Jones
content: Francis Coates-Jones(1857-1932) and his brotherHugh Bolton Jones(1848–1927) were born in Baltimore, but later studied in France underWilliam-Adolphe BouguereauandJules Joseph Lefebvre.Francis Coates-Jones,  Spring Day, Oil on canvas36⅛ x 30⅛ inches,currently available at Questroyal Gallery in NYCHe set up his studio in the famous but now demolished Sherwood Studio Building on in New York City.
